scope: Single isolated alternative technology test, not formal A/S. Main native minimizes and real other app retains foreground. Only then construct one temporary BaseWindow initially opacity=0, show=false, no taskbar/menu/Mission Control/fullscreen, non-focusable, ignore mouse before a single showInactive. Native ordered-in true is intentionally distinct from user-visible pixels. No app activation, main restore, daily data, permissions, or additional host. The temporary host and pure synthetic shell are short-lived only. Cold ordinary child created after minimize, three actual new current frames plus same view/WC restoration by user, then host closed. System Dock/CmdTab/Mission Control/black-frame/click-through requires separate real user observation, not inferred from metadata.

startupObservation.boundary: Exact private child and trusted renderer only; no raw logs, no user data, no storage/credential APIs. Original 15s target-discovery cutoff recorded; single 30s discovery budget follows actual product shell-load boundary; native readiness, original renderer/arm guards separate. Failure observation is bounded separately; no navigation or business retry.
